title: The Stamp
pitch: Kell stamps customs papers for Sal's boats. He's holding Thursday's set until Victor comes to ask. Victor isn't coming.

clue_a.label: Container three
lines: Customs papers pinned inside container three. Kell's stamp, dated next week. He's selling it to someone besides Sal.

clue_b.label: Under the gangway
lines: A biscuit tin under the gangway. Kell's stamps and inks inside. His whole trade, kept out by the water.
